mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptUserReportPrivate */ TM_REPORT SET PUBC_YSNO = 'N' , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
UPDATE /* uptClubParticipantAnon */ TB_CLPART SET USER_NUMB = NULL , REPT_NUMB = NULL , ANON_YSNO = #{anonymousYsno} , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
UPDATE /* uptUserAlimDeleted */ TB_ALIMXX SET DELT_YSNO = 'Y' WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
UPDATE /* uptUserPushDisabled */ TB_PSHSUB SET USEE_YSNO = 'N' WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
mapper.select: SELECT /* getPendingWithdrawal */ W.WTHD_NUMB , W.USER_NUMB , W.WTHD_TYPE , W.WTHD_RSON , W.WTHD_STAT , W.REQU_DATE , W.DELT_DATE FROM TH_USWTHD W WHERE W.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND W.WTHD_STAT = 'DELETE_PENDING' AND W.WTHD_NUMB = ( SELECT MAX(S.WTHD_NUMB) FROM TH_USWTHD S WHERE S.USER_NUMB = W.USER_NUMB AND S.WTHD_STAT = 'DELETE_PENDING' )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptWithdrawalRestored */ TH_USWTHD SET WTHD_STAT = 'RESTORED' , RCOV_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE WTHD_NUMB = #{wthdNumb} AND USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND WTHD_STAT = 'DELETE_PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT /* getActiveSuspCntByIdHash */ COUNT(1) FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TH_USWTHD W JOIN TH_USSPND S ON S.USER_NUMB = W.USER_NUMB WHERE W.USER_IDHS = #{userIdhs} AND S.SPND_STAT = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.SPND_TYPE = 'INDEFINITE' OR S.ENDX_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
